newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-TELECOMS - Competitive access the key - Spectrum says.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-TELECOMS - Competitive access the key - Spectrum says.

text.p: A competitive wholesale market was vital for the survival and profitability of telecoms service resellers, according to Spectrum Network Systems Ltd.

"If we don't get fair access, or world scale competitive access prices, then it will be more difficult to make money because your cost base goes up," Spectrum chief executive officer Robert Hansford told Reuters in an interview.
Hansford said the cost structure model of the North American telecommunications sector was likely to eventually prevail here as well.
While agreeing that some consolidation of resellers was ocurring, Hansford was confident about their longer term future as the Australian market moved towards deregulation in July 1997.

"In every market that has made the transition to more or less full competition, that (reselling) exists. All that means is the spreads between the wholesale and the retail are adequate to operate your business and provide a margin."
"I suspect that we will definitely get there in Australia, it's a question of when. We are not there yet, so the opportunities for resale in Australia are thin in terms of profit that can be made."
